narrative: Of 375 protected train nodes on Chameleon, 13 (3%) do not shrink their train−test confidence gap under HARP. Among failures, 15% already had clean true-class confidence >0.9: Laplace at σ=0.3 rarely erases an already near-one-hot cue after renormalization. Population LiRA therefore moves only modestly—the protector helps mid-confidence mass, not the overconfident tail.
